  // Internal logic for lab8_provided_la_nios2_qsys_0_jtag_debug_module_tck
  assign jrst_n = reset_n && !resetlatch;
  assign st_ready_test_idle = monitor_ready && !monitor_error;
  assign sr = {MonDReg, break_readreg, {dbrk_hit3_latch, dbrk_hit2_latch, dbrk_hit1_latch, dbrk_hit0_latch}};
  
  // Internal logic for lab8_provided_la_nios2_qsys_0_jtag_debug_module_sysclk
  assign jdo = {tracemem_trcdata, sr[1:0]};
  assign take_action_break_a = trigbrktype && trigger_state_1 && debugack;
  assign take_action_break_b = trigbrktype && !trigger_state_1 && debugack;
  assign take_action_break_c = !trigbrktype && trigger_state_1 && debugack;
  assign take_action_ocimem_a = tracemem_on && tracemem_tw;
  assign take_action_ocimem_b = tracemem_on && !tracemem_tw;
  assign take_action_tracectrl = tracemem_on && tracemem_trcdata[0];
  assign take_action_tracemem_a = trc_on && !trc_wrap;

  assign take_no_action_break_a = !take_action_break_a;
  assign take_no_action_break_b = !take_action_break_b;
  assign take_no_action_break_c = !take_action_break_c;
  assign take_no_action_ocimem_a = !take_action_ocimem_a;
  assign take_no_action_tracemem_a = !take_action_tracemem_a;

  assign vji_tck = 1'b0;
  assign vji_tdi = 1'b0;
  assign vji_sdr = 1'b0;
  assign vji_cdr = 1'b0;
  assign vji_rti = 1'b0;
  assign vji_uir = 1'b0;
  assign vji_udr = 1'b0;
  assign vji_ir_in = 2'b0;
